<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:tools` from the server's tools/list. Do not edit by hand. -->

## superflow_get_me

**Who am I**

Show who this Superflow API key belongs to: the member, the workspace, its plan, and the key's scopes.
Use it when the user asks which account is connected, or after a forbidden error to check the scopes.
It does not list teammates. For that use superflow_list_members.

No parameters.

Example:

```json
{}
```

## superflow_list_projects

**List projects**

List the Superflow projects (websites) this key can see, with site URL, install status and open comment count.
Use it to find a project's exact name or id, or to answer questions like which sites have the most open comments.
For the pages inside one project use superflow_list_pages. For comment counts by any other dimension use superflow_comment_stats.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | no | Filter by project name or site URL (substring, case-insensitive). |
| `include_archived` | boolean | no | Include archived projects. Default false. |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 25. |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Use it with the same filters to get the next page. |

Example:

```json
{"query":"acme"}
```

## superflow_list_pages

**List pages**

List the pages of one project with their open and total comment counts.
Use it to see which pages have feedback, to find pages with zero comments, or to get exact page URLs before filtering comments.
For the comments themselves use superflow_list_comments. For counts per page under other filters use superflow_comment_stats with group_by page.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project: its name ("Acme Dental"), site URL or domain ("acme.com"), or id (prj_...). |
| `query` | string | no | Filter by page URL or title (substring). |
| `with_counts` | boolean | no | Include comment counts per page. Default true. |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 25. |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Use it with the same filters to get the next page. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","with_counts":true}
```

## superflow_list_members

**List members and guests**

List workspace members (your team) and, when a project is given, that project's guests (clients and reviewers).
Use it to find the exact name or email to use for assignee, author or an @mention, or to see who has access to a project.
Not for the key's own identity: use superflow_get_me.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | no | Project (name, site URL or id). When given, the project's guests are included after the members. |
| `query` | string | no | Filter by name or email (substring). |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","query":"jen"}
```

## superflow_list_statuses

**List statuses**

List the comment statuses (workflow columns) in order, with which ones count as resolved.
Use it before filtering or updating by status, to get the exact status names. Give a project to include its custom statuses.
To count comments per status use superflow_comment_stats with group_by status.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | no | Project (name, site URL or id). Omit for the workspace defaults. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental"}
```

## superflow_list_tags

**List tags**

List comment tags with how often each is used. Give a project to include its project tags.
Use it to find exact tag names before filtering, tagging or bulk updating by tag.
To count comments per tag under other filters use superflow_comment_stats with group_by tag.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | no | Project (name, site URL or id). Omit for workspace-wide tags. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental"}
```

## superflow_list_comments

**List comments**

List comments in Superflow with filters. Use this to find, review or read specific comments: by project, page, status, assignee, author, tags, dates, text, device, source or agent run.
For totals or breakdowns (how many per page, per status, per assignee) use superflow_comment_stats instead, it is cheaper. For a file of many rows use superflow_export_comments.
Returns compact rows by default; set fields "full" only when you need every field. Pages with cursor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string or array of string | no | Project or projects: name, site URL, domain or id. Omit for every project the key can see. |
| `page_url` | string | no | Page URL to match. See page_match. |
| `page_match` | `exact`, `prefix`, `contains` | no | How page_url matches: exact (default; ignores the query string unless you give one), prefix, or contains. |
| `status` | array of string | no | Status names or ids, or the words "open" (every unresolved status) and "resolved". |
| `priority` | array of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical` | no | Priorities to include. |
| `assignee` | array of string | no | Assignees: names, emails, ids, "me", or "unassigned" for comments with no assignee. |
| `author` | array of string | no | Authors: names, emails or ids (usr_..., gst_...), or "me". |
| `author_type` | array of `member`, `guest`, `agent` | no | member (your team), guest (clients and reviewers) or agent (AI review agents). |
| `tags` | array of string | no | Tag names or ids. See tags_match. |
| `tags_match` | `any`, `all` | no | any (default): a comment with any of the tags. all: every tag. |
| `query` | string | no | Case-insensitive text search over every message in the thread. |
| `created_after` | string | no | Created at or after. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `created_before` | string | no | Created before. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `updated_after` | string | no | Last activity at or after. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `updated_before` | string | no | Last activity before. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `resolved_after` | string | no | Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is at or after this. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `resolved_before` | string | no | Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is before this. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `has_attachments` | boolean | no | true: only threads with attachments. false: only threads without. |
| `has_replies` | boolean | no | true: only threads with replies. false: only threads with none. |
| `has_external_link` | boolean | no | true: only comments pushed to a tracker (Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Monday) with superflow_push_comment. false: only comments without one. |
| `unanswered` | boolean | no | true: the last message is from a guest or agent and no team member replied after it. |
| `stale_days` | integer | no | Not resolved and no activity for at least this many days. |
| `device` | array of `desktop`, `mobile`, `tablet` | no | Device the comment was made on. |
| `source` | array of `widget`, `extension`, `figma`, `voice`, `api`, `agent` | no | Where the comment came from: widget (toolbar), agent, api, figma, voice, extension. |
| `agent` | string | no | AI review agent name or id (agt_...). |
| `agent_run` | string | no | Agent run id (run_... or the raw execution id). |
| `sort` | `updated_desc`, `created_desc`, `created_asc`, `priority_desc`, `page`, `number` | no | Sort order. Default updated_desc (most recent activity first). |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 25. |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Use it with the same filters to get the next page. |
| `fields` | `compact`, `full` | no | compact (default): short rows. full: every field, use only when you need anchors, metadata or authors in detail. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","status":["open"],"page_url":"acme.com/pricing","page_match":"prefix"}
```

## superflow_get_comment

**Get a comment**

Get one comment with every field: page, status, priority, assignee, author, tags, pin position, attachments, and its replies.
Use it when the user names a comment ("comment 4821", "#4821", or a cmt_ id) or after a list call to read a thread in full.
A comment number needs a project unless SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT is set. To search or list many comments use superflow_list_comments.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | yes | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |
| `include_replies` | boolean | no | Include the thread's replies. Default true. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"4821","project":"Acme Dental"}
```

## superflow_comment_stats

**Comment stats**

Count comments grouped by one dimension (status, priority, assignee, author, author_type, page, tag, project, source, device, day or week), with the same filters as superflow_list_comments.
Use it for "how many", "per page", "per assignee", "trend by week" and response-time questions (metrics avg_hours_to_resolve, median_hours_to_first_reply). It is much cheaper than listing.
To read the comments behind a number use superflow_list_comments with the same filters.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string or array of string | no | Project or projects: name, site URL, domain or id. Omit for every project the key can see. |
| `page_url` | string | no | Page URL to match. See page_match. |
| `page_match` | `exact`, `prefix`, `contains` | no | How page_url matches: exact (default; ignores the query string unless you give one), prefix, or contains. |
| `status` | array of string | no | Status names or ids, or the words "open" (every unresolved status) and "resolved". |
| `priority` | array of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical` | no | Priorities to include. |
| `assignee` | array of string | no | Assignees: names, emails, ids, "me", or "unassigned" for comments with no assignee. |
| `author` | array of string | no | Authors: names, emails or ids (usr_..., gst_...), or "me". |
| `author_type` | array of `member`, `guest`, `agent` | no | member (your team), guest (clients and reviewers) or agent (AI review agents). |
| `tags` | array of string | no | Tag names or ids. See tags_match. |
| `tags_match` | `any`, `all` | no | any (default): a comment with any of the tags. all: every tag. |
| `query` | string | no | Case-insensitive text search over every message in the thread. |
| `created_after` | string | no | Created at or after. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `created_before` | string | no | Created before. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `updated_after` | string | no | Last activity at or after. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `updated_before` | string | no | Last activity before. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `resolved_after` | string | no | Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is at or after this. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `resolved_before` | string | no | Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is before this. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `has_attachments` | boolean | no | true: only threads with attachments. false: only threads without. |
| `has_replies` | boolean | no | true: only threads with replies. false: only threads with none. |
| `has_external_link` | boolean | no | true: only comments pushed to a tracker (Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Monday) with superflow_push_comment. false: only comments without one. |
| `unanswered` | boolean | no | true: the last message is from a guest or agent and no team member replied after it. |
| `stale_days` | integer | no | Not resolved and no activity for at least this many days. |
| `device` | array of `desktop`, `mobile`, `tablet` | no | Device the comment was made on. |
| `source` | array of `widget`, `extension`, `figma`, `voice`, `api`, `agent` | no | Where the comment came from: widget (toolbar), agent, api, figma, voice, extension. |
| `agent` | string | no | AI review agent name or id (agt_...). |
| `agent_run` | string | no | Agent run id (run_... or the raw execution id). |
| `group_by` | `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `author`, `author_type`, `page`, `tag`, `project`, `source`, `device`, `day`, `week` | yes | The dimension to group by. |
| `metrics` | array of `count`, `avg_hours_to_resolve`, `median_hours_to_first_reply` | no | Metrics per group. Default ["count"]. Hours metrics may be approximate. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","status":["open"],"group_by":"page"}
```

## superflow_export_comments

**Export comments**

Export the comments that match the filters as csv, json or markdown, for a report, a spreadsheet or a client update.
Under 500 rows the file comes back inline in content; larger exports return a download_url that works for 1 hour.
To read or count comments in the conversation use superflow_list_comments or superflow_comment_stats instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string or array of string | no | Project or projects: name, site URL, domain or id. Omit for every project the key can see. |
